verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਕੈਹਾਂ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: soiee taa(n)baa ra(n)g sa(n)g jiau kaihaa(n) hoiee|

en.bdb: Mixing with tin, the copper transforms into bronze.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਜਿਸਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿਤਲ ਅਵਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: soiee taa(n)baa jisat mil pital avaloiee|

en.bdb: The same copper mixed with zinc appears in the form of brass.
Copper mixed with lead changes pewter, a brittle metal called bharath in the Punjab.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂਬਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: taa(n)baa paaras parasiaa hoi ka(n)chan soiee|

en.bdb: With the touch of the philosopher’s stone, the same copper becomes gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਤਾਂਬਾ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਖਧ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: soiee taa(n)baa bhasam hoi aaukhadh kar bhoiee|

en.bdb: When transformed into ashes copper becomes a medicine.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa sa(n)gat gun goiee ||6||

en.bdb: Likewise, though the Lord is omnipresent, yet the effects of the company of man are different over men. Knowing this much, the Lord is eulogised in the holy congregation.
